blocks.text: The Way of Śiva: Your Consciousness Has Been Running the Entire Universe and Somehow You Didn’t Notice.
blocks.directed: The Way of Śiva: Your Consciousness Has Been Running the Entire Universe and Somehow You Didn’t Notice.

blocks.text: Ninth century, give or take. The Himalayas. Snow-covered mountains. Ancient temples. A man named Vasugupta is about to receive what tradition describes as a revelation from Śiva himself.
blocks.directed: Ninth century, give or take. The Himalayas. Snow-covered mountains. Ancient temples. A man named Vasugupta is about to receive what tradition describes as a revelation from Śiva himself.

blocks.text: According to one famous account, Śiva appears to Vasugupta in a dream and directs him towards a rock bearing a secret teaching.
blocks.directed: According to one famous account, Śiva appears to Vasugupta in a dream and directs him towards a rock bearing a secret teaching.

blocks.text: Twenty-two in the first section. Ten in the second. Forty-five in the third.
blocks.directed: Twenty-two in the first section. Ten in the second. Forty-five in the third.

blocks.text: No elaborate mythology. No 600-page introduction. Just the metaphysical equivalent of a bloke walking into your house, informing you that you’ve misunderstood the entire nature of reality, and disappearing.
blocks.directed: No elaborate mythology. No 600-page introduction. Just the metaphysical equivalent of a bloke walking into your house, informing you that you’ve misunderstood the entire nature of reality, and disappearing.

blocks.text: And unlike the Tantrasāra, which was written by Abhinavagupta as an extensive systematic exposition, this thing is absolutely compressed.
blocks.directed: And unlike the Tantrasāra, which was written by Abhinavagupta as an extensive systematic exposition, this thing is absolutely compressed.

blocks.text: A single word can contain an entire metaphysics.
blocks.directed: A single word can contain an entire metaphysics.

blocks.text: Fortunately, Abhinavagupta’s disciple Kṣemarāja wrote the Śivasūtravimarśinī, which helps unpack what on earth Vasugupta is on about.
blocks.directed: Fortunately, Abhinavagupta’s disciple Kṣemarāja wrote the Śivasūtravimarśinī, which helps unpack what on earth Vasugupta is on about.

blocks.text: We’re going through all 77 in their traditional order, with the authentic Sanskrit, accessible glosses, and an original, mildly unhinged narration grounded primarily in Kṣemarāja’s interpretation. The jokes are ours; the sūtras are real.
